17.0 NON-FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS

DR-17.1Performance, on the owner's ordinary Windows PC: dragging a handle in a 20-layer, 20,000-stitch figure redraws at 60 frames a second; opening a 100-layer figure takes under 2 s; a full regression run of 1,000 items takes under 10 minutes.
DR-17.2Start-up to a usable Home under 3 s with 2,000 catalogue items (no start-up rebuild: P-10).
DR-17.3Readability (DR-2.5) is a requirement, not a preference: every file has its header comment; a reviewer unfamiliar with the code can say what a file does from its header and its first screen.
DR-17.4Dependencies: Vite (development only), Playwright (tests only), and in vendor/ only what a feature cannot do without (d3-delaunay for Voronoi; Acorn for the importer, O-4). Each is pinned and listed with why.
DR-17.5Browsers: current Chrome and Edge on Windows; Safari on iPad for review (read-only).
DR-17.6Accessibility at the owner's level: every control has a visible label; keyboard use for the common commands (DR-11.3); colour is never the only signal (greyed items also say why).
DR-17.7Security is local: the service listens on localhost only, checks origins (DR-8.7), refuses paths outside the library (DR-8.4); Learn is the only outbound connection and is the owner's press each time (DR-14.8).

18.0 MIGRATION FROM VERSION 1

18.1 Figure files (format 1)

V1's figure format is fixed and documented (R-11) and may only gain fields, so every V1 figure can be read.

V1 (format 1)V2 (format 2)
layers[i] with id, lid "L"+(i+1), objectVersion, role, includeInOutput, visible, deleted, color, params, transformlayer with the same lid, role, transform, output and visibility; generator = V1 id; settings = the generator's "from V1" mapping of params keyed by objectVersion; deleted layers dropped (their numbers stay used)
params.points and named fields (pt1 ...)handle points: each a new point number, from the named fields (preferred over the points mirror)
points: anchored {layer, arm, t, feature?}attached point {on: lid, path: arm, t} or {on, feature}
points: free {ox, oy}free point at (ox, oy) transformed by the layer
points: handle {h, hname}the handle's point (by name)
welds [{members}]members that are free or handle discs become one shared point; a group with an anchored disc becomes an attachment to that disc
units "px", scale mm/px, nailunits "legacy", scale carried, nail carried
drawOrder (indices, top first)order (lids, top first)

18.2 Draw objects

Each of the 14 V1 registry objects is rewritten as a generator (D-5) after a one-page feature list agreed with the owner (FR-6.3.9), with a "from V1" settings mapping. Known particulars: Parametrics gained handles (centre, size) on v1-finish; Linked Circles strokes its circles itself (O-16); Circular Parabola (Multi) and Linked Circles are kept for the sketching purpose, not because a template needs them.

18.3 Scripts, hints and approved copies

DR-18.1Every V1 pattern and gallery script runs in the host unchanged (DR-9.5); its recorded geometry is compared with V1's approved copy (FR-6.17.4).
DR-18.2V1's approved regression copies (tests/regression/) are the baseline for that comparison; they are made on the owner's PC before cut-over.
DR-18.3The 282 Ideabook hint scripts convert to hint documents (DR-16.11); their shared routines map to kernel connectors and composites (FR-6.2.5a, b).
DR-18.4Saved Draw variations ("secondary objects") import through the same mapping as layers.
DR-18.5V1 remains usable throughout (D-1); cut-over is the owner's decision at CP-8.
